title: Tag publication denied on the first run
root_cause: The first run of the publication workflow reaches the tag push, but its GitHub token has only read access to repository contents. The server rejects the push; granting contents write permission would allow this operation. There is no successful baseline from which to attribute the failure to a change.

relevant_evidence.why: The remote rejects the tag push for insufficient write access.
The workflow grants only read access to repository contents.
